source.title: AMD FY2025 annual report on official investor-relations website
source.publication_note: The issuer IR ARS listing associates this 124-page annual report with 2026-03-27, also the SEC ARS filing date. The SEC PDF attachment differs in bytes from the current IR asset; first public availability of these exact IR bytes is not established. The 10-K filing event is not this asset's publication date.
source.revision_note: The underlying 10-K and 10-K/A (0000002488-26-000021) were filed on 2026-02-04. The amendment corrects the swapped Client unit-shipment and ASP growth percentages; the IR wrapper body already contains the corrected 15% and 31% figures. This does not mean a separate complete 10-K/A is appended. Note 2 says some FY2024 and FY2023 amounts were reclassified: these are FY2025-presented comparisons, not original FY2024 observations. Equivalence of the current IR asset and the SEC ARS attachment is not asserted.
